notes.title: DeliSpace Public Release
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/0e27e1948c90d2902d501f854ce242cfa878f23a.png

hires from 30.08.2024 7AM CEST!
Do you have what it takes to become the best courier in the universe?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/df14c6a35ad488b6ee8968ce1dd3603c11400310.gif
Job requirements
To apply for a job you will need a suitable interface that facilitates the connection to your ship:
- Windows 32/64 bit PC
- OSX (Mac) with Intel or Apple Silicone processor
A one time application fee of $9.99 (or equivalent in your currency) is necessary. If you are unsure we highly recommend our free demonstrational app that simulates the realities of space courier experience with 94%* accuracy.

From 8th of September 2024 we will additionally support a portable Nintendo Switch interface (please mind a slightly higher application fee of $14.99)

NO SPACESHIP DRIVING LICENSE REQUIRED! We cover your pilot exam during onboarding with our simulated environment: T.U.T.O.R.I.A.L.

Job description
We offer a job in ever changing environment. Working 10 hours every day of the week? Not here. We feature a shift based approach: split your job in short shifts consisting of 5 missions that you can complete within minutes and work when you have time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/8444566968910ec02287a108cfc9c1ede2702345.gif

Your responsibilities include:
- delivering packages between various planets in 13 star systems,
- maintaining and upgrading your ship,
- choosing appropriate load-out to adapt for challenges of each world,
- mastering 9 different package types, and their effect on your ship,
- minimising damage to the shipped goods and the hull of your ship by avoiding obstacles (including but not limited to: asteroids, meteor showers, space debris, etc.) and navigating under influence of: time-space continuum altering entities (including but not limited to: black holes, time crystals, etc.) as well as any other physics-based phenomena (including but not limited to: pulsars, nebulas, etc.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/e5c66d549b72ad318c6c3d3fff0420f29711bd57.png

What we offer?
- opportunities to expand your pilot license with 5 additional license exams,
- friendly, competitive environment for comparing your performance with other pilots with speedrun mode in the exams,
- flat rate payout that can be used to buy upgrades and unlock new worlds (see. payout table in Appendix A)
- accessible bonus system based on collecting mail that increases your payout,
- motivational awards system based on your achievements
- an official certificate signed by the CEO of HexyArts Corp, granted upon establishing maximum reputation with all planets using our services.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891244/7d93994164ee00610992c98c6436d9e44bb8f38d.png


*not confirmed with any actual research

notes.title: v. 0.6.2 NextFest Hotfix
notes.notes:
Thank's a lot for the help with pinpointing the controller issues. 
It's the smallest update yet but probably the most important.
Have fun flying!

notes.title: Feedback changes & Bugfixes 0.4.0
notes.notes:
The most notable difference is that you now collide with planets. Other graphics were also altered so now it should be perfectly clear what you can collide with and what is just a decoration.

 Changelog 

Added
- Full controller support in Galaxy Map, Exams and Tutorial
- Minimap keymap hint
- Pausing game when joycons are disconnected
- Accept button cue in main menu

Changed
- Better, in-detail tutorial
- More contrasty Sputnik
- Glitch planet broadcasts signal constantly
- Planets are now collidable
- Easier first level
- Slower asteroid rings around planets
- Better docking bay graphics
- Less inertia on ship rotation (more precise controls)

Fixed
- Reward selection with controller
- Some unlocks costing 0 coins
- Pinging animation
- Multiple selection highlights in menu
- Hardlock in menu
- Fall from menu through Galaxy view straight to gameplay (w/ controllers)
- Meteor despawns and performance
- Pickup-zone despawns
- UI issues of reward rerolling
